items.title: Jerome Richardson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Well that’s a beautiful record. And your soprano playing is gorgeous. Roland Kirk.

ctx.x: “Manteca.” And I played a soprano solo in the middle. And they were trying to decide how they would play it, and I told Quince I said, “Why don’t you do it in six?” So he did it in six, and then put strings behind it. So it sounded good. Even I have to say so.
Yeah. Well that’s a beautiful record. And your soprano playing is gorgeous. Roland Kirk. © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-
“I Never Told You So.” Do you know how it goes?
